turns.speaker: system
turns.content: "Let's discuss SwiftCart's challenge: their repeat purchase rate has dropped from 35% to 22% despite having 2M active users. Alex, Jordan, Sam - what initial questions or thoughts do you have about this retention problem?"

turns.speaker: provoker
turns.content:
"Before we jump to solutions, let's see the data—what's the customer segmentation showing? If we don't know which user groups are churning fastest, we're just guessing at fixes." 

(Then immediately turn to another colleague) "Alex, you're always quick to suggest loyalty programs—but how would that address the root cause if we don't even know why they're leaving?"
